comment: Audit-set membership and rule inputs. Selectors live here rather than as attributes in src/, so production markup is not annotated for the benefit of a test.

grid.comment: Chromium lays out in 1/64px units, so an exactly-on-grid value can be reported as 15.984375. Three of those units is 0.047, and the smallest real defect here is a 2px half-step. The tolerance absorbs float representation and nothing else.

separation.comment: 8px is two grid steps and the smallest PatternFly spacer above xs. minTargetSize is the WCAG 2.2 AA floor.
